title: Trace the Wine Bluetooth D-Bus assertion
changes: Record a repeatable Wine service assertion, the matching upstream Bluetooth NULL-call defect and the exact remaining runtime prerequisite without altering shared Wine resources.
validation: Wine wine-dbus-process-smoke-zkjnk_35 passes without the assertion; Wine wine-dbus-reader-trace-qxwtl8he reproduces it in winedevice.exe while the reader passes. Both servers drain. Static audit wine-dbus-binary-audit-ijsvoxgk identifies the defective guard in installed Wine 10.0 and links Wine MR7302.
limitations: The exact triggering call stack and physical Bluetooth impact remain unproved. A corrected matching Wine runtime is not available locally; changing shared Wine resources requires authorization and focused revalidation. No performance measurements or Linux game tests were run.
